src: The worms told me about the wandering Titan. And how he visited the Villa.
Changes lie ahead. And grave danger, for all of the Flesh.
At least Morrowmeat is alive still. I was glad to see this.
Do you still think that the Feeder is dangerous?
Yes, I truly think he is.
The Feeder threatens what is most precious to me: The lives and the souls of the Titans.
I do not see clearly what he plans to do. But I fear that it cannot be good. Not for the Titans, and not for us, their protectors.
I became a Worm Shaman because I care, and I won't stop caring.
Do you care, too?
I don't know.
Hmmh.
You should be careful how you spend your time here on Nexus.
The worms will be watching you.
Yes.
I'm glad, **forename** of the Flesh.
What do you think of Morrowmeat?
It's an abomination.
Eh, I don't think he's so bad.
No. This city I mean. This graveyard built from stone and ashes.
Morrowmeat is sick. He's suffering. But still he is exploited to provide meat.
This is not how it should be. The Titans and their profound souls should nurture our souls. They should enrich us.
Not only through their flesh.
I have the means to enter the Temple.
Then enter and talk to Mother. Meet her with respect.
And do not mention my name.
I'll stay outside.
Why?
Mother and I had a difference of opinion.
It should not trouble you. Just don't talk to her about it.
By the Titans, **forename** of the Flesh.
It is good to see you still being alive.
Aksa.
It's been a while since I've been here in the Perished City.
{She sniffs.}
It reeks of rotten flesh.
What are you doing here?
{She sighs.}
I wanted to visit one of my old friends.
But I couldn't. I won't. She wouldn't be happy to see me.
She's here in the Temple?
{She nods.}
Yes, **forename** of the Flesh. It's her temple. It's Mother's temple.
Welcome back.
Did you get into the city?
Not yet.
*hiss*
Blergh.
Grrr.
Kchr.
[Examine the animal.]
{The animal is large and bulky. It seems to be friendly in nature.}
{The animal is quiet and relaxed.}
{The animal is experiencing a lot of stress currently.}
[Attack the animal.]
[Try calming the animal.]
Easy now, it's all right.
{You are successful in calming the animal.}
*gurgles*
It's staring at me.
[Summarize your thoughts about the painting.]
Hmmh. Still a flesh thingy with a big eye.
I think it's a flesh thingy with a big eye.
[Continue pondering the painting.]
[Ponder the painting.]
Welcome back.
The maggots are still there, I guess?
Yes. they're back there in the cellar, where we keep our meat.
Just hurry with this, okay?
I got the poison.
Very good. Could you take care of the maggots then, please?
Ok.
I'm done with the Flesh Maggots.
Really? Great!
The guests were already beginning to wonder why the meat started to taste differently.
Here, take this as a thank you.
Any work around here?
Something worrying you?
Actually, yes. We got a little pest problem.
Again.
Oh, alright.
But since you're asking, wanna help us out with that?
Nah.
Ok then. I guess it was too much to hope to have a helping hand here.
Sure.
Great.
You see, flesh maggots have made their nest inside the bar's meat reserves.
And to get rid of 'em we need something potent.
Eh... Is that the meat you're serving here?
Yes.
Like I said, we need something potent against flesh maggots.
But we ran out of poison.
There's a doctor up in Tauris. He sold us the last batch. Try it over there.
Alright. Will do.
I heard the doctor is dead.
What? Ohh, fuck me. What a miserable world.
I have to make do without the poison then. Thanks for letting me know.
Anything else?
So this is the Puke Bar...
Anything interesting?
Always. There are travelers stopping by here.
Drinks and food are good. Obviously.
We have a Cyberwomb room that may or may not be functional.
And the Bar is old enough that it has some secrets I can't tell you about.
Obviously.
Correct.
Do you know where I can find the Oracle?
Never heard of an Oracle.
But if you're religious or something like that you should probably head east towards New Delphi.
Occasionally pilgrims are making a stop here and trying to convert me, haha.
Ok. Thank you.
Welcome to the Puke Bar.
I'm Eldred.
What do you need? Booze? Meat? Something else?
Looks like this machine is connected to the gate.
But the gate is open now. I don't need this anymore.
[Try to open the gate.]
Yeah, looks like this is gonna work.
Looks like someone's living here.
Welcome, **forename**.
You have returned.
Now, speak your desire.
Can I revisit your mind?
That is an odd request.
But, since you've been there already, I guess I feel comfortable having you around again.
Are you ready for this?
Not right now.
Good. I'll be here, waiting for you.
Yes.
Then stay calm and embrace my thoughts...
Do you feel better now?
Yes, I do.
Thank you for caring about me.
It's all fractured still. And hazy.
But, finally, I feel like myself again. I am seeing again. I am a master of my own mind again.
You were not the master of your own mind?
No. He caught up to me. He found me.
Who?
The Feeder did.
This is what I had feared. This is why I had asked for help.
The Feeder reached me, and not only that, but he chained me, manipulated me, brainwashed me.
He was the master of my mind.
What did he want?
He's in search of the Wormwound.
The Wormwound?
The origin. The flesh. I don't really know. I feel it as a presence, but I don't know what it is.
It's connected to the Flesh Nexus. As am I.
I have an infection. I feel like I'm connected to the flesh, too.
I know you have a connection. I wouldn't have reached you over that distance, otherwise.
Now that my mind isn't that fuzzy anymore... Are you really a worm shaman?
No, I am not.
Hmmh. Well, that's a pity. But I guess you helped me nonetheless.
You think this Wormwound might give me answers about my infection? Or heal me from it?
I... honestly don't know. I'm sure you'll find answers when finding the Wormwound, but I don't know what kind of answers those will be.
So where's the Wormwound?
I don't know. The Feeder questioned me. Painfully.
The agony. The sweet, sweet agony.
But I couldn't tell. Because I don't know.
I feel that it's up north from here. And that's what he felt from me, too.
The Perished City will have the answers. It has to.
How do I get to the Perished City?
Last I heard, the city is closed. But I listened to many travelers throughout the years. Some of them found a path through the mountains.
There's something else though...
Yes?
The Feeder. If the Feeder is interested in the Wormwound, and searching for it, then this does not bode well.
He killed the philosopher.
Oh. This makes me sad to hear.
He's dangerous and up to no good. So if you would wander north, in the search of the Wormwound, please be careful.
I will.
Farewell. I will rest now.
Goodbye.
Yes, I am.
That is good to hear. It's good to know there are still people around taking care about the Flesh Titans.
You asked for help.
You touch me. You embrace me.
You open your mind, and then I let you in, and you see what's wrong, what's messed up.
You'll fix it. You fix my mind. You're a worm shaman from the wasteland.
I will have to think about this.
Then speak your desire.
Alright. Let's try this.
Worm shaman. You’ve heard my call. You are here to rescue me.
A great deal of responsibility rests on your shoulders, this I can tell.
I’ve cried. I screamed.
But is it too late? Or is there a sense of hope we can latch on to?
Who’s speaking here? Be quiet. ... BE QUIET!
He told me you would come. But I already knew that you would come.
He's not omniscient, you know?
I suppose he can foretell, too?
Not that I can. Nobody can.
You have to help me. This is all too much. The memories... I cannot silence them anymore. You have to help me.
Speak! The Oracle awaits your words.
I want to leave this place now.
I won't hold you back anymore.
You can leave anytime.
THERE IS NO GOING BACK! We are together now.
About the rules...
The rules. I cannot abide the rules. ... Do you know the rules?
No.
Then don't ask me about them.
I don't know.
No, you do not know. I can feel it. I can read it.
I know enough about them.
I... this is strange. I can sense that you're speaking the truth.
You're not the Feeder. You're not me. Who are you?
I am still myself. In your mind.
You've seen the rules?
Yes. But I think they are guidelines, not rules.
The Feeder told me to strictly follow the rules.
He is wrong. You're an Oracle. You interpret. You guide. You don't follow rules.
But the voices...
You don't have to listen to all voices all the time.
You talk to some. Not all of them.
Ok. I'll let your mind go now.
How do you feel?
I feel better now. You should leave my mind so we can talk in the real world.
Welcome to my domain. I am the all-seeing mind. I watch and guide all living beings that approach me.
But who can last an eternity? What strength does the all-seeing mind have against the tides of time?
A crack, a fracture, widening due to neglect, and being worn out by the steady rhythm of incoming guests.
What is the purpose of those who approach me? Do they want to see the world like I do?
Or do they want to be told that there is nothing further to be seen?
Do they need reassurance, and their fear taken away, or are they ready to see more possibilities?
What is your desire?
You asked for my help.
Where are we?
We are nowhere. We are everywhere at once. We are inside my mind, and this mind is endless.
Your body remains in that cave.
THERE IS NO GOING BACK! We are together now.
The rules! I forgot about the rules again.
I imposed my will on those seeking guidance. I created fate instead of showing it.
The Feeder said to follow the rules.
Can I see those rules?
The rules? Are those to be followed?
